# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 7 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Sinaiticus (ch 1-31) / P.Mich. 130 (ch 32+), Shepherd of Hermas 7 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_007_page_001.jpg

---

## Vision 2, Chapter 3

**1** The tower is being built by the six young men who came with her. And many thousands of other men are bringing stones, some from the deep sea, and some from the land; and they are handing them to the six young men, who are taking them and building. **2** All the stones that are dragged from the deep sea they place in the building just as they are, for they are smooth and fit precisely into the joints. And they fit so tightly together with one another that their joints cannot be detected. And the building of the tower is appearing as if it were built of one stone. **3** As for the other stones, those brought from the dry land — some of them they throw away; some they put into the building; others they break in pieces and throw far away from the tower. **4** Now there were many other stones lying around the tower. Some were not used in the building; others were thrown far from the tower; others were found cracked; others were white and round, not fitting into the building. **5** I saw other stones being thrown far away, which when they were thrown fell on the road, and yet did not stay on the road, but rolled from the road to trackless ground. Others fell into the fire and burned; others fell near the water and could not roll into the water, though they wanted to roll in and enter the water. **6** After she had showed me these things she wanted to hurry away. I said to her, "Lady, what good does it do me to see these things, if I do not know what they mean?" She replied to me, "You are an impertinent fellow, wanting to know about the tower." "Even so, lady, tell me." **7** "This tower," she said, "is the Church." I said, "And who are the six young men who are building it?" She said, "These are the holy angels of God, who were created first of all, to whom the Lord handed over all his creation to increase and build up and to be lords of all creation. Through them, therefore, the building of the tower will be completed." **8** "And the other people, who are bringing the stones — who are they?" "These also are holy angels of God, but these six are superior to them. The building of the tower, then, will be completed, and all will rejoice together around the tower and will glorify God, because the building of the tower has been completed." **9** I said to her, "Lady, I would like to know about the stones, what is their meaning?" She replied, "The stones that are square and white and fit their joints: these are the apostles and bishops and teachers and deacons who walked in accordance with the holiness of God, and served God as bishop and teacher and deacon with purity and holiness — some of whom have already fallen asleep, and some who are still living. And they always agree with one another, and so they have peace with one another and hear one another. **10** Therefore their joints are fitting in the building of the tower." "And who are the ones dragged from the deep sea?" "These are those who have suffered for the name of the Lord." **11** "And the other stones, brought from the dry land?" She said, "These are those who have not suffered, but by reason of their holy life have pleased God and walked in the commandments of the Lord." "And those being rejected — who are they?" **12** "These are those who have sinned and wish to repent; therefore they have not been thrown far from the tower, because they will be useful for the building if they repent. Those then who will repent, if they do repent, will be strong in the faith, if they repent now while the tower is still being built. For after the building is completed, there will be no more room for repentance, but you shall be rejected." **13** "And the rejected ones, the cracked ones — who are they?" "These are the sons of iniquity, and they have believed hypocritically, and no wickedness has departed from them; therefore they have no salvation, for because of their wickedness they are not useful for the building." **14** "And the white round ones that do not fit into the building — who are they?" "For how long will you be without understanding?" she said. "These are those who have faith but who also have the riches of this age; and when tribulation comes, because of their riches and their business affairs they deny their Lord." I said to her, "Lady, then when will they be useful for the building?" "When," she said, "their riches which bewitch them are cut away, then they will be useful to God. For just as the round stone cannot become square unless it is cut down and loses something of itself, so also those who are rich in this age cannot become useful to the Lord unless their wealth is cut away from them. **15** Learn first from yourself: when you were rich you were useless, but now you are useful and profitable for life. Be useful to God, for you yourself are being taken from this stone."

---

*EMET note: This is the primary allegory of the entire Vision section. The tower = Church; the stones = different categories of believers. Full exegesis in ch 8.*
